text:
Lina (design): quick feedback on rollout UI mock — using a tiny "Ramp 10%" pill that expands to slider. fits narrow screens but check a11y.
Rob: nice compactness. make sure expand/collapse is announced (aria-expanded) and the pill is keyboard focusable.
Sam: agree. also add explicit "Apply" button in expanded view to avoid accidental traffic changes.
Lina (design): good call. copy change: primary label "Ramp" instead of "Canary". tooltip: "staged rollout / A-B".
Rob: small perf note: avoid firing metrics fetch on hover. debounce 250ms and use cache.
ci-bot: preview deployed for branch "ux/ramp-pill" at https://console.redwood.ai/preview/ux/ramp-pill :white_check_mark:
Lina (design): thanks. I'll update Figma and attach brief a11y checklist.
Sam: i'll run quick a11y smoke tests once deployed.
Lina (design): aiming for next sprint. :rocket:
